DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SE-
CURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 
2026 
The SPEAKER pro tempore. Pursu-
ant to clause 8 of rule XX, the unfin-
ished business is the vote on passage of 
the bill (H.R. 7147) making further con-
solidated appropriations for the fiscal 
year ending September 30, 2026, and for 
other purposes, on which the yeas and 
nays were ordered. 
The Clerk read the title of the bill. 
The SPEAKER pro tempore. The 
question is on the passage of the bill. 
The vote was taken by electronic de-
vice, and there were—yeas 220, nays 
207, not voting 4, as follows: 
[Roll No. 42] 


b 1641 
Mr. GOLDMAN of New York changed 
his vote from ‘‘yea’’ to ‘‘nay.’’ 
Ms. STEFANIK changed her vote 
from ‘‘nay’’ to ‘‘yea.’’ 
So the bill was passed. 
The result of the vote was announced 
as above recorded. 
A motion to reconsider was laid on 
the table.
